title: Costume Sketch Class
content: This costume sketch class is drawing a model in a Civil War costume. In the far room, plaster casts are standing in the soft light.It's a mixed group of men and women, with men sitting in the front row. They're working from the light of a skylight, just visible in the upper left. The room is set up for electric light as well. The upper electric light has a curved blocker to keep the light from spilling into the far end of the room.---Thanks, Kev!
